retention.stated: free tier clusters are automatically suspended after 1 week of inactivity and deleted after 4 weeks of inactivity if not reactivated; reactivation prevents deletion

one cluster per account on Free
no connection limit is published for the free tier; recorded as a gap

identity_cost.detail: email or GitHub signup; no card on Free

evidence.proved: 'The free tier includes 1GB RAM and 4GB disk storage'; the free tier is 'limited to 1GB RAM and 4GB disk without high availability'
the create-cluster page states free tier clusters are suspended after 1 week of inactivity and deleted after 4 weeks if not reactivated
evidence.quote: If unused, free tier clusters are automatically suspended after 1 week, and deleted after 4 weeks of inactivity if not reactivated. You can upgrade to a standard cluster at any time.

record.notes: 4 GB of disk holds roughly 1.4 million vectors at 768 dimensions and 4 bytes per component, before index overhead. That puts the ~1 million vectors in circulation in the right order. The figure comes from arithmetic, not from a measurement. What happens at 1 GB of RAM is not published. The page offers an upgrade and states no refusal, throttle or deletion. That absence is documented, and it is not headroom.

record.provider: Qdrant Cloud Inference (free models on a free cluster)
record.category: embedding inference inside a vector database cluster, free models with no stated token cap

free_tier.stated: BM25 and a dense model such as all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are free to use on free-tier clusters, with no token charge; larger models (mxbai, SPLADE) run on metered tokens with a monthly free allowance of up to 5 million tokens per model on paid clusters only. No rerank model is listed
free_tier.notes: unverified: no request or token cap for the free models appears on the pages read; the Inference tab of a cluster in the console lists the current models, which the page reader could not open

record.tooling: the Qdrant client sends text or images in the upsert and query calls and the cluster embeds them; external providers (OpenAI, Cohere, Jina AI, OpenRouter) are proxied with a per-request provider key header. Python client uses QdrantClient(url=..., api_key=..., cloud_inference=True) and the same route works from the JS/Rust/Java/C#/Go SDKs; without cloud_inference the Python client embeds locally via FastEmbed.
record.chaining: embedding and search in one call on the same free cluster; the free tier is the cluster of 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk

limits.value: unverified: no rate or token limit for the free models is published on the pages read

identity_cost.detail: the log-in page offers an email address, Continue with Google or Continue with GitHub; unverified: whether the sign-up asks for a card

record.confidence_note: The endpoint pattern, routes, method and api-key auth are quoted from first-party Qdrant docs; the dedicated remote inference service is internal and not a caller-facing endpoint; the concrete per-cluster endpoint and the Inference-tab catalogue are behind a sign-up.

evidence.quote: Start at no cost: BM25 and a dense model like all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are free to use, including on free-tier clusters.
evidence.proved: BM25 and the dense all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model are free, including on free-tier clusters

evidence.quote: Free models carry no token charges, and paid Qdrant Cloud users receive a monthly free allowance of up to 5 million tokens per model.
evidence.proved: free models carry no token charges; the 5 million token monthly allowance is for paid clusters

evidence.quote: Inference runs in the EU for clusters in EU regions and in the US for clusters in all other regions. Free models are hosted in the US region but can be called from any region.
evidence.proved: the free models run in the US region and can be called from any region
the Qdrant Cloud log-in page offers an email, Google or GitHub sign-in
inference search uses POST to the cluster /collections/<collection>/points/query route with the cluster API key in the api-key header
inference is server-side and invoked by passing an Inference Object instead of a precomputed vector
evidence.quote: When using Qdrant Cloud Inference or Qdrant’s BM25 model, embeddings are generated server-side. Instead of pre-computed vectors, you pass Inference Objects when ingesting or querying data.

evidence.proved: the cluster REST and gRPC APIs are the inference interface; there is no separate inference API
evidence.quote: Use inference through the Qdrant SDKs and the REST or gRPC APIs when upserting points and when querying the database.

evidence.proved: free Qdrant-hosted models need no extra API key and work on free-tier clusters
evidence.quote: Models hosted by Qdrant Cloud, listed in the Models tables. They need no extra API key, and the free ones also work on free-tier clusters.

evidence.proved: external-provider inference is proxied through the Qdrant API with a per-request provider-key header
evidence.quote: Provide the provider’s API key in the request header (`openai-api-key`, `cohere-api-key`, `jina-api-key`, or `openrouter-api-key`).

record.binding_note: no limit on the free models is published; the free cluster's own 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk bound what can be stored
record.endpoint: https://<cluster-id>.<region>.cloud.qdrant.io:6333 (REST) / :6334 (gRPC); inference via PUT /collections/<collection>/points?wait=true and POST /collections/<collection>/points/query; no standalone inference host
record.interface_detail: Server-side inference through the cluster own REST/gRPC API: pass a Document (text) or Image object with a "model" name in place of a precomputed vector in the upsert and query routes; auth is the cluster API key in the api-key header. Free Qdrant-hosted models need no extra key. Qdrant-hosted inference runs in the US region for free models and can be called from any region. External-provider models are proxied through the same cluster API with the provider key in a per-request header (openai-api-key / cohere-api-key / jina-api-key / openrouter-api-key).
record.notes: A concrete cluster endpoint and the Inference-tab model/usage details are unverified: behind a sign-up. The 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-18 captures of the marketing page differ in bytes but not in quoted text. No request could be sent: the inference route is a per-cluster data plane at <cluster-id>.<region>.cloud.qdrant.io, so no hostname resolves until an account has created a cluster, and this research does not create accounts.
